name: codex-linux-community
description: An unofficial Linux desktop client for the OpenAI Codex CLI

scripts.start: npm run build:renderer --silent && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.dev: npm run build:renderer --silent && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron . --dev
